title: Photography
script_graphic_directions: Graphic: four category tiles with sample shots.

shots.framing: B-roll: a phone lowers out of frame and a real camera comes up. Shutter click.
shots.camera: Phone drops out of frame bottom; camera rises into frame; white flash on the shutter click
shots.storyboard_caption: Cold open: phone drops out, real camera comes up

shots.framing: Full-screen shared title card

graphics.anim: Red band sweeps up at -9° (10 frames), shield scales 0.9→1.0, text tracks in from right 30 px

shots.transition_in: Hard cut on a music hit
shots.storyboard_caption: Shared title card (from the graphics kit)

shots.framing: Full-screen category card

graphics.title: PHOTOGRAPHY
graphics.subtitle: JUNIOR & SENIOR HIGH
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title punches in 1.15→1.0 scale (8 frames), subtitle letter-spaces in, small logo fades in bottom right

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Put the phone down. Seriously. Phone photos are disqualified in SoCal Classic photography.

graphics.anim: Red strip wipes in from left, then black bar unrolls right (8 frames); reverse to exit
Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Welcome to the SoCal Classic Fine Arts explainers. This one's for photographers.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, name bars come up

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic graphic

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: There are four categories. Human Portrait, Landscape, Still Life and Action.

graphics.title: 4 CATEGORIES
graphics.subtitle: PORTRAIT · LANDSCAPE · STILL LIFE · ACTION
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title slides up 40 px with ease-out (12 frames), subtitle fades in 6 frames later

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Photography is for Junior and Senior High. Each school can enter two students per category.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: You can enter one photo per category, in up to two categories.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: And a photo you entered in a past year can't come back.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Shoot on a real camera. A DSLR, a mirrorless or a point-and-shoot.

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic checklist

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: You can edit color, cropping, contrast and size. That's it.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: You can't change what's in the picture. Nothing added, nothing removed, no distortion.

graphics.title: EDITING
items: No AI fill or sky swap
graphics.anim: Header bar slides in from left; unchecked items sit at 40% opacity; each item gets a red check pop and goes to full opacity at its build_at time (seconds from shot start)

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: And no AI tools that change content. So no generative fill, and no sky replacement.

graphics.title: EDITING
items: No AI fill or sky swap
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Do every edit yourself, and write each one down.

graphics.title: EDITING
items: No AI fill or sky swap
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: List the program you used. List every color change, and by what percent.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Then write down what you cropped and why, and how much you lightened or darkened it.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Print it at eight by ten. Any other size is disqualified. Color or black and white are both fine.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Slide it into a plastic sleeve. No frames.

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic checklist

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: At check-in, bring your print in its sleeve and three judging sheets.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Staple a three-by-five card to the back of the sleeve. Name, school, grade and category.

graphics.title: CHECK-IN
graphics.anim: Header bar slides in from left; unchecked items sit at 40% opacity; each item gets a red check pop and goes to full opacity at its build_at time (seconds from shot start)

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Add an Artist's Idea Statement with each judging sheet. And your edit list, if you changed anything.

graphics.title: CHECK-IN
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Last, bring a USB with your original RAW file.

graphics.title: CHECK-IN
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: B-roll: USB goes into a second laptop
shots.camera: Push-in to the USB going into the laptop

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Test that USB on another computer first. If it doesn't work, the judges can't check your photo, and it's disqualified.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.storyboard_caption: Insert: USB goes into a second laptop

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Real camera. Honest edits.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Eight by ten. Working USB.

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic end card

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Questions? Email us. The address is on your screen.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: See you February twenty-fourth through the twenty-sixth at Pacific Baptist School!

graphics.anim: Red band drops in at -9 degrees (10 frames), shield fades up, QUESTIONS? then email then dates stagger in 6 frames apart; hold, then fade to black over the last 15 frames
